title: Gịnị ka A1, A2, B1, B2, C1 na C2 pụtara?
invitation: Koodu ọkwa ndị a na-apụta n’akwụkwọ, kọs, ule, ngwa na profaịlụ asụsụ gburugburu ụwa. N’ebe a, anyị na-akọwa ihe ha pụtara n’ezie, ihe mere nkà gị ji nwee ike ịdị n’ọkwa dị iche iche, na otú Gef si eji ha.
summary: Gef na-eji CEFR A1–C2 dịka maapụ nkịtị nke ikike asụsụ, na-edobe Pre-A1 maka nzọụkwụ mbụ, ma na-agbakwunye nhọrọ nke ya ‘Nnọọ were were / Ọkwa onye asụsụ bụ nne’ n’elu C2. Ikike gị n’ezie nwere ike ịdị iche n’ịgụ, ige ntị, ikwu okwu, ide, mmekọrịta na mediation.

blocks.title: Maapụ nkịtị nke ikike asụsụ
blocks.text: A1 ruo C2 sitere na Common European Framework of Reference for Languages, ma ọ bụ CEFR. Ọ na-enye ndị na-amụ, ndị nkụzi, ụlọ akwụkwọ, ule na ndị mbipụta ụzọ nkịtị isi kwuo maka ikike asụsụ. A na B abụghị akara ụlọ akwụkwọ, Gef anaghịkwa eche na asụsụ niile nwere otu ụzọ okwu ma ọ bụ grammar.

blocks.title: Pre-A1 · Nzọụkwụ mbụ
blocks.text: Pre-A1 bụ mpaghara tupu A1. Ị nwere ike ịmata okwu, akara, ụda, aha, ọnụọgụ ma ọ bụ ahịrịokwu ole na ole e ji n’isi, ma ka chọrọ enyemaka dị ukwuu. Ihe CEFR nke oge a nwere Pre-A1. Na scale dị mfe Gef, etiti pụtara enweghị ihe ọmụma ma ọkwa mbụ n’èzí bụ A1.

blocks.title: A1 · Onye mbido
blocks.text: Na A1 ị nwere ike iji obere asụsụ mee ihe bara uru n’ọnọdụ ama ama na doro anya. Ị nwere ike ịghọta ihe dị mkpirikpi ma dị mfe ma gbanwee ozi bụ isi. Ịga A2 pụtara ịdabere obere na ahịrịokwu e ji n’isi ma jikwaa ọnọdụ kwa ụbọchị karịa n’onwe gị.

blocks.title: A2 · Kwa ụbọchị
blocks.text: Na A2, ndụ kwa ụbọchị na-amalite ịdị mfe ijikwa n’asụsụ: ndị mmadụ, ebe, ọrụ ma ọ bụ ụlọ akwụkwọ, ịzụ ahịa, njem, oge na mkpa ozugbo. Ịga B1 pụtara ijikọ echiche n’akụkụ ogologo, kọwaa ihe kpatara dị mfe ma jikwaa ọnọdụ a na-apụghị ibu amụma nke ọma.

blocks.title: B1 · N’onwe ya
blocks.text: Na B1 ị nwere ike ijikwa ọtụtụ ọnọdụ nkịtị na-enweghị ịhazi ahịrịokwu ọ bụla tupu oge. Ị nwere ike soro isi echiche nke asụsụ doro anya ma dị ogologo ma kwuo okwu jikọtara ọnụ gbasara ahụmahụ, atụmatụ, mmasị, echiche na nsogbu. B2 chọrọ oke okwu, nkọwa, ọsọ na njikwa karịa.

blocks.title: B2 · Nnwere onwe siri ike
blocks.text: Na B2 ị nwere ike isonye nke ọma na nkwurịta okwu dị ogologo, tụlee echiche doro anya na nke abstract, ma rụọ ọrụ n’ọtụtụ ọnọdụ mmekọrịta mmadụ, agụmakwụkwọ na ọrụ. Ịga C1 chọrọ njikwa finer nke inference, nuance, register, nhazi na style.

blocks.title: C1 · Dị elu
blocks.text: Na C1, asụsụ na-abụ ngwá ọrụ na-agbanwe agbanwe. Ị nwere ike ijikwa ihe siri ike, ghọta ihe a na-ekwughị kpọmkwem, ma gbanwee tone na style dịka ọnọdụ si dị. Ịga C2 bụ karịa omimi, obere ọdịiche, reformulation ngwa ngwa, mpaghara pụrụ iche na njikwa ziri ezi karịa ndepụta grammar ikpeazụ.

blocks.title: C2 · Ikike dị elu nke ukwuu
blocks.text: C2 bụ ọkwa ntụnyere nkịtị kacha elu nke CEFR. Onye C2 nwere ike ijikwa asụsụ siri ike nke ukwuu na njikwa dị fine nke meaning, structure, implication na style. C2 apụtaghị ịma okwu niile, ghara imehie mgbe ọ bụla, ma ọ bụ ghọọ onye asụsụ bụ nne n’onwe ya.

blocks.title: Nnọọ were were / Ọkwa onye asụsụ bụ nne · Nkọwa onwe kachasị elu nke Gef
blocks.text: Gef na-agbakwunye nhọrọ nke ya n’elu C2: Nnọọ were were / Ọkwa onye asụsụ bụ nne. Nke a abụghị CEFR C3 ma ọ bụ certificate gọọmenti. Onye na-abụghị native speaker nwekwara ike ịhọrọ ya ma ọ bụrụ na ikike ya n’ezie n’otu nkà ahụ yiri nke onye toro eto na-asụ asụsụ ahụ nke ọma dịka asụsụ nne. Gef na-akọwa ikike, ọ bụghị agbụrụ.

blocks.title: Ikike asụsụ gị bụ shape, ọ bụghị otu mkpụrụedemede
blocks.text: Nkà isii nwere ike ịdị iche: Ịgụ, Ige ntị, Ikwu okwu, Ide, Interaction na Mediation. Ị nwere ike ịbụ C1 n’ịgụ, B2 n’ige ntị na A2 n’ikwu okwu. Radar graph nwere axis isii na-egosi ọdịiche ndị a.

blocks.title: Ọkwa abụghị checklist nke lesson niile gara aga
blocks.text: Ịmụ asụsụ anaghị eto n’otu ụzọ. Ị nwere ike ịhapụ grammar principle mbụ ma nwee advanced ability n’ebe ọzọ. Gef na-eji ọkwa kọwaa pattern izugbe nke ihe ị nwere ike ime; B2 apụtaghị na lesson A1 na A2 niile zuru oke.

blocks.title: Gef ugbu a na-atụ Reading, ọ bụghị hexagon niile
blocks.text: Gef ugbu a bụ reading-first app. Ị nwere ike ịkọ nkà isii n’onwe gị, mana evidence sitere n’akwụkwọ, reading lessons, comprehension na dictionary use kwesịrị imetụta naanị Reading estimate. Gef ekwesịghị ịkọ Speaking, Listening, Writing, Interaction ma ọ bụ Mediation site n’ihe ị mere mgbe ị na-agụ.

blocks.title: A2 label n’akwụkwọ na-ekwu maka akwụkwọ ahụ
blocks.text: Ọ bụrụ na Gef kpọọ akwụkwọ A2, nke ahụ bụ reading-difficulty signal. Imecha akwụkwọ bụ evidence gbasara Reading, mana ọ naghị egosi na nkà ndị ọzọ niile bụ A2. Otu iwu ahụ dị na ule: jụọ ihe e tụrụ n’ezie.

blocks.title: Gịnị bụ mediation?
blocks.text: Mediation bụ inyere meaning aka gafee oghere. Ọ gụnyere translation na live interpreting, ichịkọta text siri ike, ịkọwa idea n’asụsụ dị mfe, iziga ozi n’etiti ndị na-enweghị otu asụsụ, ma ọ bụ ịgbanwe okwu esemokwu ka akụkụ abụọ ghọta ya.

blocks.title: Course progress nwere ike inye clue bara uru
blocks.text: Ụfọdụ app na-ebipụta mmekọrịta course ha na CEFR. Na Duolingo Score, 0–29 bụ A1, 30–59 A2, 60–99 B1, 100–129 B2, na 130–160 dị na C1/C2. Nke a bụ course progress, ọ bụghị independent test nke nkà niile; Gef na-edobe original score dịka otu evidence.

blocks.title: Ụwa nwere ọtụtụ system nke ọkwa asụsụ
blocks.text: CEFR abụghị naanị system. ACTFL dị na US language education, ILR 0–5 n’ụfọdụ government context, CLB/NCLC na Canada, JLPT N5–N1 maka Japanese, na HSK maka Mandarin. Ebumnuche ha dị iche, ya mere Gef anaghị eche perfect one-to-one equivalent maka label ọ bụla.

blocks.title: Ihe atụ: Japanese JLPT
blocks.text: Site na Disemba 2025, result JLPT a gafere nwere ike igosi official CEFR reference level dabere na JLPT level na total score. Mana JLPT na-atụ language knowledge, reading na listening; ọ naghị atụ speaking, writing ma ọ bụ interaction. Mapping kwesịrị imetụta naanị nkà e tụrụ n’ezie.

blocks.title: Chinese HSK na-agbanwe, ya mere version dị mkpa
blocks.text: HSK bụ standardized Mandarin test. HSK 2.0 nwere level isii na historical relationship na CEFR. HSK 3.0 ọhụrụ e mere ka ọ nwee stages atọ na levels itoolu, mana transition nke 2026 ka na-aga. Gef na-edobe HSK version ma were nine-level-to-CEFR conversion dịka estimate ruo mgbe official concordance pụtara.

blocks.title: Framework abụghị test
blocks.text: CEFR bụ framework maka ịkọwa proficiency. Exam na organization nwere ike align results ha na ya. Score chọrọ context: nkà a tụrụ, otú na mgbe alignment mere, na ma result bụ official ma ọ bụ estimate. Gef estimate ekwesịghị igosipụta dịka official CEFR certificate.

blocks.title: Enweghị otu universal A2 word count
blocks.text: Vocabulary dị mkpa, mana CEFR anaghị define A1, A2 ma ọ bụ B1 site n’otu fixed word count. Asụsụ dị iche na word segmentation, writing system, compounds, morphology na organization of meaning. English vocabulary estimate agaghị ecopy ozugbo na asụsụ niile.

blocks.title: Otú Gef si eji levels
blocks.text: Gef na-eji CEFR A1–C2 dịka shared coordinates, Pre-A1 maka first steps, na ọkwa nke ya Nnọọ were were / Ọkwa onye asụsụ bụ nne n’elu. Akwụkwọ na-enwe reading difficulty, profile nwekwara ike idobe skill values isii. Language-specific curriculum data na-akọwa concepts, word senses, grammar, scripts na text types iche iche.

blocks.title: Gefstimate bụ estimate, ọ bụghị diploma
blocks.text: Ọ bụrụ na Gef n’ọdịnihu jikọta evidence ugboro ugboro, English UI nwere ike ịkpọ estimate ahụ Gefstimate. A gaghị amanye wordplay ahụ n’asụsụ ndị ọzọ. Ọ bụ evidence-based estimate maka otu skill, ọ bụghị official CEFR certificate, Gef kwesịkwara inwe ike ịkọwa evidence ejiri.

blocks.title: Kedu ka ị ga-esi gaa level ọzọ?
blocks.text: Ọ bụghị site n’imeju otu magic progress bar. Future Gef estimates nwere ike jikọta lesson performance, difficulty nke ihe ị gụrụ nke ọma, amount of help, comprehension results na skill-related evidence ndị ọzọ. Vocabulary na grammar na-enyere aka, mana ha abụghị otu gate. Otu akwụkwọ dị mfe ekwesịghị ịkwalite gị n’onwe ya, otu ụbọchị siri ike ekwesịghị iweda gị n’onwe ya.

blocks.title: N’ụzọ dị mkpirikpi
blocks.description: Zero pụtara na ihe ọmụma amalitebeghị. Pre-A1 bụ nzọụkwụ mbụ. A1 na A2 na-ewu basic everyday ability. B1 na B2 na-egosi independence na-eto. C1 na C2 bụ high, flexible, precise proficiency. Gef na-agbakwunye ọkwa nke ya Nnọọ were were / Ọkwa onye asụsụ bụ nne. Ikike gị n’ezie bụ shape nke nkà isii.
